title: Presentations deck slides.json schema
description: DETERMINISTIC deck pipeline input. An AI agent produces THIS file from the source material (transcript/brief). build_deck.py then renders it with ZERO further AI judgement: it renders the authored rich prompt for each slide verbatim (with the mandatory English/Latin-only pin appended when absent), calls KIE.ai GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst, downloads one full-bleed 16:9 PNG per slide, and assembles a .pptx. The agent NEVER generates images itself. All wording that must appear on a slide must be written, spelled correctly, in the 'copy' array — KIE renders that text INTO the image.

slide.description: 1-based slide ordinal. Determines slide order in the deck AND the render filename (slide-01.png, slide-02.png, ...). Must be unique and contiguous starting at 1.

scene.description: Photographic scene description for the background image — what is literally in frame (subject, setting, lighting, mood, color palette, camera framing). Describe a PHOTOGRAPH, not a slide. Do NOT put the slide copy here; copy goes in the 'copy' array. Example: 'A confident Black woman entrepreneur standing in a sunlit modern office, soft morning light from a large window behind her, warm neutral palette, shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm, professional editorial photography.'

copy.description: The EXACT text that must appear rendered on the slide, in reading order. Index 0 is treated as the HEADLINE; remaining entries are subheads/body lines. Spell every word correctly letter-for-letter; KIE renders these verbatim into the image. Keep lines short (slide copy, not paragraphs). Example: ["Northwind Co", "Three moves that doubled our pipeline in 90 days"].

logo.description: Optional brand/logo wordmark to render on the slide (e.g. 'NORTHWIND CO'). If present, build_deck.py instructs KIE to place this wordmark as a small clean lockup (typically a corner). Omit if the deck has no per-slide logo. NOTE: this is a TEXT wordmark rendered by KIE, not an image-to-image logo placement; the deterministic t2i pipeline does not pass logo image files.

layout.description: Optional human-readable hint for WHERE the text sits and how the composition is arranged, fed into the KIE prompt (e.g. 'headline lower-left over dark gradient, subhead beneath, logo top-right', 'centered hero title, copy stacked in lower third'). If omitted, build_deck.py uses a safe default: headline upper area, subhead/body in the lower third, high-contrast legible placement.

mode.description: Image generation mode. The DETERMINISTIC pipeline uses ONLY 't2i' (gpt-image-2-5-sunburst-text-to-image) — the copy is rendered into a freshly generated photographic scene. (Image-to-image logo placement remains available via the separate kie_generate.py helper but is out of scope for build_deck.py.) Defaults to 't2i' if omitted.

media.description: Optional typed per-slide media choice (Skill 72 directive Section 14.2, MG-036). This is the MEDIA choice, never the image-generation 'mode' above. Absent media means {"kind": "still"}: the slide is the deterministic KIE still image, exactly as before. The motion alternative names an authenticated Skill 72 component by its job manifest, its approved render receipt, and its poster; build_deck.py validates the governed MG-035 package (package record, MG-034 QC verdict, poster parity, receipt binding, hashes) before anything is embedded, and every failure degrades the slide to its still with a reason code in working/checkpoints/motion.json. Motion is elected per deck (intake want_motion_graphics, default NO) and capped at 2 pieces per deck (Slot A slide 1, Slot B a section divider). Invariants JSON Schema cannot express (the placement rectangle lies inside [0,1] and preserves 16:9; paths resolve inside the run root with symlinks resolved before containment; hashes match the receipt and the package record) are enforced by build_deck.validate_motion_slide_artifacts.

motion_manifest_path.description: Run-relative path of the Skill 72 job manifest for this slide's component (e.g. working/motion/slide-02/manifest.json).

approved_render_receipt_path.description: Run-relative path of the approved Skill 72 render receipt binding the rendered artifact by hash and job identity (e.g. working/motion/slide-02/renders/artifacts.json).

poster_path.description: Run-relative path of the component's poster PNG; byte-identical to the slide's QC PNG (renders/slide-NN.png) and to the MG-035 package poster.

placement.description: Rectangle normalized to the slide: x/y within [0,1], width/height positive and at most 1, the whole rectangle inside the slide and preserving the component's 16:9 (the inside-slide and aspect invariants are enforced in code).

playback.description: Playback contract (the canonical contracts-v2 playback shape); must equal the MG-035 package record's playback values, enforced in code.

webinar_policy.description: How the same component joins the webinar render: fit is exact_slot, hold_final, or approved_loop; no implicit speed-stretch or crop is permitted (enforced in code). duplicate_audio must be false: the component is silent and the parent narration owns the audio.

examples.scene: A confident Black woman entrepreneur standing in a sunlit modern office, soft morning light from a large window behind her, warm neutral palette, shallow depth of field, shot on 85mm lens, professional editorial photography, cinematic.
copy: Three moves that doubled our pipeline in 90 days
examples.layout: headline lower-left over a soft dark gradient, subhead directly beneath the headline, logo wordmark small in the top-right corner

examples.scene: An overhead flat-lay of a clean modern desk with a laptop showing a rising line graph, a coffee cup, and a notebook, bright natural daylight, minimalist, lots of negative space on the right side, professional product photography.
copy: Most pipelines leak at the follow-up stage — not the lead stage
examples.layout: headline and subhead stacked in the right-side negative space, dark text on the light background, logo wordmark small in the bottom-right corner
